qualification.details: Assistant Controller of Examinations: Officers under the Central/State/U.T. Governments/Universities/Statutory, Autonomous Bodies or Research and Development Organizations holding analogous posts on regular basis, or at least 5 years of Regular service in the post in the PB3, with Grade Pay of Rs. 5400 or higher. Accounts Officer: Officers under the Central/State/U.T. Governments/Universities/Statutory/Autonomous Bodies/ Research and Development Organizations holding analogous posts on regular basis, or with 2/3 years regular service in the relevant field in the grade pay of Rs.4800/4600 respectively. Librarian Grade I: Officers under the Central/State/U.T. Governments/Universities/Statutory/ Autonomous Bodies or Research and Development Organizations holding analogous posts on regular basis or with 3 years regular service in the grade pay of Rs. 4200/- in the relevant field and possessing a Bachelor Degree in Library Science or Library and Information Service from a recognized University/Institute. Or B.Sc. Degree or equivalent from a recognized University and Bachelor Degree or Post Graduate Diploma or equivalent in Library Science from a recognized University or Institute. And 5 years' experience in a library of repute. Ability to use computers - Hand on experience in office applications, spreadsheets and presentations.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for AIIMS Mangalagiri Non-Faculty Posts?
faq.answer: The last date to apply online for the AIIMS Mangalagiri Non-Faculty Group "A & B" Posts is 22nd October 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the total number of vacancies released by AIIMS Mangalagiri?
faq.answer: AIIMS Mangalagiri has released a total of 3 vacancies for Non-Faculty Group "A & B" Posts.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is online.

faq.question: Q4. What is the maximum age limit for the posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all the Non-Faculty Group "A & B" Posts is 56 years.

faq.question: Q5. Which organization is conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: All India Institute of Medical Sciences Mangalagiri (AIIMS Mangalagiri) is conducting this recruitment.

faq.question: Q6. What is the job type for these positions?
faq.answer: The job type for these positions is Deputation.

faq.question: Q7. What are the salary levels for the advertised posts?
faq.answer: The salary levels range from Level-7 to Level-11 as per the 7th CPC.

faq.question: Q8. What is the minimum qualification required for the Librarian Grade I post?
faq.answer: The minimum qualification for Librarian Grade I is a Bachelor Degree in Library Science or equivalent, along with 5 years of experience in a library and computer skills.

faq.question: Q9. How should the hard copy of the application be submitted?
faq.answer: The hard copy of the application, duly forwarded by the Cadre Controlling Authority with NOC, Vigilance clearance, and minimum last 5 years APARs, should be submitted.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification PDF?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be accessed through the "Important Links" section of this article.
